hurling_curator.text: Welcome to the hurling museum. Hurling has been played in Ireland for at least 2,000 years, so it is not going anywhere.
The hurley is carved from ash. The ball, the sliotar, has a cork core and a leather cover, and it can fly well over 100 kilometres an hour.
Kilkenny teams are the Cats, in black and amber. Cork and Kilkenny have a long and friendly feud. Do not mention it near either.
